background: Rabobank is a Dutch cooperative bank owned by its local member banks, the leading lender to Dutch agriculture and a large domestic mortgage lender, with a global food and agriculture franchise, funded by Dutch deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, with one on a positive outlook since 16 Sep 2026 and the last move a one-notch upgrade on 12 May 2026. Every ratio sits in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 20.2%, leverage of 7.7%, LCR of 175% and NSFR of 130%. Since 31 Mar 2025 CET1 has risen 1.8 points and leverage 0.5 points, with liquidity broadly flat. There is no weak spot in the figures to 30 Jun 2026.
